_meta.title: Working analysis: DTC supplements LP at 4.1% baseline (subscription)
_meta.why_strong_example: DTC ecom analysis showing how 4% can be excellent for the niche; identifies third-party testing badges + UGC reviews + founder story as load-bearing; warns specifically against 'modernization' that loses real-customer photos.

trust_anatomy.element: Star rating + review count (4.7★ from 12,400+ reviews)
trust_anatomy.why_working: Volume of reviews matters more than score; 12k+ signals ongoing operations + audience size; specific count beats 'thousands of customers'

trust_anatomy.element: UGC photo wall — real customers with first names + cities
trust_anatomy.why_working: Real ≫ stock for DTC wellness audience; photos with names + cities = the audience self-recognizes

trust_anatomy.element: Third-party testing badges (NSF Certified for Sport, cGMP)
trust_anatomy.why_working: Supplement audience checks for these; absence is a deal-killer; presence is a quiet but heavy signal
Founder-led brand authenticity; the 'why I made this' story beats abstract benefit copy
Subscription audience needs clear exit path; this overcomes the 'trapped in subscription' fear

preservation_zones.reason: 18% load. Hiding count for 'cleaner star display' loses the volume signal. 12k reviews IS the credibility.
16% load. Replacing real customer photos with stock or models has tanked DTC wellness pages by 10-15% in published case studies.
12% load. Supplement audience-specific signal; absence reads as 'sketchy brand'.
10% load. Founder authenticity is differentiator vs commodity supplements.
8% load. Subscription-friendly cancellation copy overcomes the lock-in fear.

change_safe_zones.reason: Tertiary content; reordering is safe to test
Ingredient callouts can be tested for visual variants without changing content
'Get 15% off your first subscription' vs 'Take the quiz for personalized recs' — testable variants
Press logo selection (which 4-6 logos shown) — test for highest recognition by ICP

warnings_for_downstream: DO NOT propose replacing real customer UGC photos with studio models. 16% load + audience self-selection signal.
DO NOT propose hiding/removing review count for 'cleaner display'. Volume is the credibility, not the score.
DO NOT propose removing third-party testing badges. Supplement audience checks for these specifically.
DO NOT propose removing founder story or money-back guarantee. Subscription audience needs both authenticity + exit-path reassurance.
Tests on email-capture INCENTIVE COPY ('15% off' vs 'quiz' vs 'free shipping') are highest-leverage change-safe.
